lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase Ba6Nb2O12 (reduced formula Ba3NbO6) crystallizes in space group I-4 (No. 38) with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Nb in a tetrahedral environment of four O neighbors, while Ba centers show nine-coordinate O environments. The polyhedra connect through corner-sharing between Nb tetrahedra and both Ba and O polyhedra, with additional edge- and face-sharing observed between Ba and O polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
